adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6` from awaiting `model.findMembers()` in `afterModel` (which would propagate AJAX rejections through the route's promise chain and thus into Ember's error handling) to calling `model.findMembers();` in `setupController` without returning/awaiting it. In parallel, `Group#findMembers` now performs an AJAX request and sets `members` on the model, and the template iterates `{{#each m in members}}` rather than `model`. If the members request 403/500s, nothing in the route catches/handles that rejection, and `members` will remain unset/empty, so the page can render an empty members table instead of transitioning to an error route.
